ownership-certs.steps-taken: The applicant searched the Land Registry index map, consulted Lewisham about unregistered highway and bridge land and could not establish ownership of all unregistered parcels.
ownership-certs.note: Schedule 5 identifies seven freehold and four qualifying leasehold interests. The current notified-person component records proprietor identity, address and notice date but has no fields for title number, property parcel or FH/LH status. Organisation names are preserved in person.last-name because notified-person currently requires a person object.

pre-app-advice.advice-summary: Extensive pre-application consultation under a Planning Performance Agreement signed in October 2014. Further details are in the submitted Statement of Community Involvement, Design and Access Statement and Planning Statement.

processes-machinery-waste.site-activity-details: The extent of plant is shown on the application drawings.

proposal-details.description: Outline planning application for phases 1-3, with detailed permission for phase 1, for a residential-led mixed-use phased redevelopment including demolition, up to 1,132 homes, 10,413 square metres of non-residential floorspace, an energy centre, buildings of 3 to 24 storeys, access, parking, landscaping, public realm, open space and a water feature.

site-locations.address-text: Land bounded by Evelyn Street, Oxestalls Road, Grove Street and Dragoon Road, London
site-locations.description: Includes land beneath Oxestalls Road bridge and excludes Scott House, 185 Grove Street.

waste-storage-collection.waste-storage-area-details: Communal waste bins in bin stores provided.
waste-storage-collection.separate-recycling-arrangements-details: Co-mingled waste collected in communal euro bins.

additional-properties.portal-location: Crown, New Baltic, Park, Bridge and Victoria Wharves, bounded by Grove, Dragoon and Evelyn Streets together with Oxestalls Road, London, SE8
additional-properties.notes: The source is a hybrid application: outline permission for phases 1-3, with detailed permission for phase 1. The current specification has no dedicated hybrid application type, so outline-some is used as the closest profile. The submitted schedules state up to 568 phase 1 homes, while the public register summary states 562. Submission data preserves 568.
